counter.label: deaths per 10,000 houses, by water company

connections.why: William Farr's General Register Office gave Snow his lists of the dead, and at Farr's suggestion its registrars recorded the water company of every cholera death in 1854.
John Snow, who traced cholera to the Broad Street pump, was London's leading anesthetist, whose writing on chloroform the ether frame quotes.
